hints.title: Partitioning into Non-Empty Groups
hints.text: Partitioning n distinguishable performers into j non-empty groups corresponds to the Stirling number of the second kind S(n, j).

hints.title: Stage Permutations and Scoring
hints.text: Assigning j groups to x distinguishable stages gives P(x, j) = x. / (x - j). permutations. Scoring each group with one of y values gives y^j ways.

hints.title: Stirling DP Table and Total Sum
hints.text: Compute S(n, j) using DP recurrence S(i, j) = S(i-1, j-1) + j * S(i-1, j). Sum S(n, j) * P(x, j) * y^j across j from 1 to min(n, x).

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numberOfWays(self, n: int, x: int, y: int) -> int:
        MOD = 1_000_000_007
        max_j = min(n, x)
        
        # Stirling numbers of the second kind S(n, j)
        dp = [[0] * (max_j + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
        dp[0][0] = 1
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            for j in range(1, min(i, max_j) + 1):
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j - 1] + j * dp[i - 1][j]) % MOD
                
        total_ways = 0
        perm = 1
        for j in range(1, max_j + 1):
            perm = (perm * (x - j + 1)) % MOD
            ways = (dp[n][j] * perm) % MOD
            ways = (ways * pow(y, j, MOD)) % MOD
            total_ways = (total_ways + ways) % MOD
            
        return total_ways
```

complexity.notes: DP table fills in O(n * min(n, x)) time, followed by O(min(n, x) * log y) summation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating over all x^n assignments directly leads to exponential runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n * min(n, x)) space for Stirling number DP table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes Stirling numbers of the second kind combined with stage permutations and group scoring.
